author: TMRX
description: Configure a product from the Price List catalog, generate a customer quote, push parts to a Work Order, or start a Rental.
versionDescription: Two refinements to the per-section quote discount (all sections — Base Product, Options, Startup, Calibration, etc.): (1) relabeled 'Discount (%)' to 'POS Discount (%)' and styled it bold orange on-screen so it stands out as an editable control instead of blending into the other financial rows. (2) On the downloaded PDF only, the POS Discount (%) / Discount ($) rows are now omitted entirely for any section where the discount is 0% — on-screen the editable field always stays visible so it's still discoverable, but a printed quote no longer shows '0%' discount lines on every section.
